name: Stormbringer: Body of Lightning deals its additional damage when the ally deals damage (#11546)
contract: Body of Lightning 500041 (Spell.dbc, server set /srv/coa/server-data/dbc): Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (42) on TriggerSpell 800406 with ProcChance 100 and ProcFlags 0, and its tooltip promises 'While active, damage dealt now deals an additional 800406 Nature Damage to up to N enemies'. 800406 is SCHOOL_DAMAGE (EffectBasePoints 74, TargetA 6 enemy, EffectChainTarget 4, SchoolMask 8). With ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips the aura and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returns zero, so the aura never procs, which is the report. The expected behavior comes from the tooltip and the DBC: after the buff lands, one damaging cast by the ally procs 800406 on the damaged enemy, and its chain of 4 reaches an enemy the ally's own spell never targeted. Call Lightning 500040 is a single-target damage cast (TargetA 6, no chain), so damage on a second dummy can only come from the chain. The control cast before the buff must produce no 800406. No absolute damage is asserted since it scales with level and spell power.
